final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT archstat AS a, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS c FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.a AS a, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / s2.t AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL AND s2.t <> 0), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS m FROM s3) SELECT s3.a, s3.c, s3.r, s3.r - s4.m FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.r > s4.m
